about: PROPOSED, UNSIGNED. One Proofline task, XC-89: `x402conf-svm mcp`, a seller mode for paid MCP tools on a live server, on top of XC-33's MCP transport (X1). One unpaid tools/call of the named tool, after initialize unless --no-initialize (1 or 3 requests), paced and logged like `live` (XC-88), graded X1 on the tool result and P3, P4, P5 and P7 on the PaymentRequired in it. Nothing is paid or signed. MCP is JSON-RPC over POST, so this is not covered by the contract's 'live mode is GET-only' rule for the Python live mode; like `x402conf-svm live`, it is for servers whose operator agreed, and the docs say so. If the owner wants no POST to third parties from any CLI, do not sign this task. Owner's go, 2026-10-25T12:48Z, in chat: 'fix mcp and endpoints and then test'. Under D-AUTO-4 sys may batch-sign contracts covered by an owner go; nothing here binds until the owner key signs it into proofline.json.

tasks.title: x402conf-svm mcp: X1 and the offer checks on one unpaid call of a paid MCP tool, paced
tasks.description: ts/src/mcp-transport.ts: McpSession and McpOptions take a fetch (a paced one for live servers) and initialize: false; unpaidToolCall returns X1 and the answer; a RequestBudgetExceeded is never swallowed as a dead server. ts/src/mcp-seller.ts: checkMcpSeller runs X1 then grades the PaymentRequired in the result (structuredContent, else content[0].text) with P3, P4, P5 and P7. ts/src/cli.ts: `mcp --url --tool [--arguments json] [--no-initialize] [--min-interval] [--max-requests] [--out]`. ts/example/mcp-server.ts gains a sessionless option. Docs: README, USING, ts/README, SPEC, COVERAGE, CHANGELOG.
